recognize_zh: 低倍下息肉狀的大腸黏膜片段，固有層被密集的淋巴浸潤瀰漫撐開，腺窩被均勻隔開但形態大致保存、表面上皮完整，呈現非破壞性的黏膜淋巴浸潤。
features: Polypoid colonic mucosal fragment at low power
Dense, diffuse lamina propria infiltrate spacing crypts widely apart
Crypts rounded and preserved with intact goblet cells; surface epithelium intact
No ulceration, necrosis or lymphoid follicles evident
Adjacent fragments with similar dense infiltrate
describe_en: Low-power H&E section shows a polypoid fragment of colonic mucosa in which the lamina propria is diffusely expanded by a dense lymphoid infiltrate, spacing the crypts apart. The crypts and surface epithelium are preserved, and there is no ulceration, necrosis or follicular architecture. This non-destructive, diffuse mucosal lymphoid expansion correlates with the polypoid endoscopic lesions and is consistent with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract in this case.

ddx.vs: Benign lymphoid polyps show well-formed reactive germinal centers and a polyclonal mixed B/T infiltrate.
MCL forms similar polyps but the infiltrate is CD20, CD5 and cyclin D1-positive.
MALT lymphoma shows lymphoepithelial lesions and B-cell (CD20) positivity.
